scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:third-party && npm run check:docs && npm run check:ci-scope
scripts.check:ci-scope: node --test tools/ci-scope.test.mjs tools/release-plan.test.mjs tools/apply-version.test.mjs tools/publish-release.test.mjs tools/release-gate.test.mjs tools/check-docs.test.mjs tools/fetch-vendor-firmware.test.mjs
scripts.check:rust: npm run check:riir && npm run check:unsafe && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --all-targets && cargo check -p nvstraps-core --no-default-features
scripts.build:firmware: cargo build -p nvstraps-uefi --release --target x86_64-unknown-uefi && cargo run -p nvstraps-ffs -- pack target/x86_64-unknown-uefi/release/NvStrapsReBar.efi target/x86_64-unknown-uefi/release/NvStrapsReBar.ffs && cargo run -p nvstraps-ffs -- inspect target/x86_64-unknown-uefi/release/NvStrapsReBar.ffs && npm run build:external-efi
scripts.prepare:desktop: rustup target add x86_64-unknown-uefi && npm run build:firmware
scripts.check:firmware: cargo test -p nvstraps-ffs && npm run build:firmware
scripts.tauri:simulated: tauri build --debug --no-bundle --features simulated-machine --config src-tauri/tauri.simulated.conf.json -- --config profile.dev.package.nvstraps-ffs.opt-level=3 --config profile.dev.package.lzma-sdk-rs.opt-level=3 --config profile.dev.package.oxiarc-lzma.opt-level=3 --config profile.dev.package.flate2.opt-level=3 --config profile.dev.package.zlib-rs.opt-level=3 --config profile.dev.package.sha2.opt-level=3
